problem: Part‑time and gig workers often need to swap or pick up last‑minute shift changes, but coordinating via chat groups leads to missed opportunities, confusion, and unpaid hours.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive web app that lets workers post available shifts, browse nearby openings, and claim them instantly, with simple calendar view and local storage persistence.

competitors.name: Shiftboard
competitors.difference: ShiftSwap Lite is free, no login, works entirely client‑side, no corporate onboarding

competitors.name: When I Work
competitors.difference: Provides only employer‑driven scheduling; our app focuses on peer‑to‑peer swaps

features: Create a shift offer with date, time, location and notes
Browse open shifts filtered by distance and time
Claim a shift with one click; the claim is stored locally
Calendar view of your own posted and claimed shifts
Responsive design for phones and tablets

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer premium filters (radius, skill tags) for $1.99/month after 1,000 active users
monetization.free_tier: All core features remain free; premium adds advanced search and export to calendar

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish repo on GitHub and enable GitHub Pages
Share in relevant subreddit communities (r/retail, r/gigwork) and local Facebook groups
Collect feedback via a short Google Form linked from the site
potential_customers: local coffee shop staff looking for extra hours

marketing_content.tagline: Swap shifts in seconds – keep your schedule full and your wallet happy.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚀 Introducing ShiftSwap Lite – the free, no‑login tool for gig and part‑time workers to post, find, and claim last‑minute shifts. Try it now on GitHub Pages and never miss a payday again! #gigwork #shiftswap

tests: Create a shift, then refresh the page – the shift should persist in the list
Filter shifts by time range – only matching shifts appear
Claim a shift – it moves from open list to your claimed list and is saved after reload
next_improvements: Add optional email notification via mailto links
Implement distance calculation using browser geolocation
Allow export of claimed shifts to iCal
